」
目眩がする。
体はもう踏ん張っていられない。
……死ぬ。
最後の最後で、耐えられなかった。
なら、どうせ耐えられないのなら、力を抜くべきか。
そうすれば少なくとも、ヤツをもう一度あの孔にたたき込め

pages.en:
“Kh… hah—”

The world spins.

My body cannot hold its ground much longer.

…I'm going to die.

At the very end, I wasn't strong enough to endure.

Then should I surrender my strength, since endurance is impossible anyway?

At least that would drag him back into the void—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……! Haa”
I feel dizzy.
I can’t brace myself anymore.
…I’ll die.
I can’t endure it at the very end.
Should I loosen up since I can’t brace myself?
If I do so, I should be able to push him back into the void

pages.ja:
「
って、舐めるな……！ こんなコトで道連れになんてされてたまるか……！」
萎えかけた手足を奮い立たせる。
この腕が千切れるのが先か、ヤツの鎖が千切れるのが先か、それとも、ヤツが這い出てくるのが先か。
どっちだっていい。こうなったら最後の最後まで全力で抗って、派手に散ってやろうじゃないか……！

pages.en:
“—Like hell…! I'm not letting you take me with you over something like this…!”

I lash my failing limbs back into life.

Will my arm tear off first, will his chain break, or will he crawl free before either can happen?

It makes no difference. If this is how it ends, I'll fight with everything I have until the final instant—and go out spectacularly…!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Don’t take me so lightly…! I won’t let you take me with you…!”
I gather my courage.
Will my arm rip off first, will his chain rip off first, or will he come out first?
I don’t care either way. I’ll fight until the very end and die gallantly…!

pages.ja: “……ふん。おまえの勝手だが、その前に右に避けろ”
pages.jaRuby: “……ふん。おまえの勝手だが、その前に右に避けろ”
pages.en: “*…Hmph. Do as you please, but first move to your right.*”
pages.mirrorMoon: “…Heh. You can do that if you wish, but dodge to your right before you do that.”

pages.ja:
「え？」
咄嗟に振り向く。
視線は遠く、荒野となった境内へと向けられる。
すれ違うように、何かが通り過ぎた。

pages.en:
“Huh?”

I spin around.

My gaze travels far across the temple grounds, now reduced to a wasteland.

—Something passes by, scarcely missing me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Huh?”
I turn around instantly.
I look back at the compound which has turned into a flat field.
At the same time, something passes by me.

pages.ja:
「貴様
アー、チャー」
……鎖が外れる。
ヤツは、最後に。
意外なものを見たような顔で、天の鎖を放していた。

pages.en:
“You——Ar…cher…”

…The chain falls away.

At the very end, wearing the expression of a man confronted with something wholly unexpected, Gilgamesh releases the Chain of Heaven.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“YouArcher…”
…The chain is released.
Looking like he saw something unexpected, Gilgamesh lets go of the chain.

pages.ja:
「
」
尻餅をつく。
呆然とする俺の前で、孔は手の平ほどの大きさまで縮み、やがて消え去っていった。

pages.en:
“——”

I collapse onto my backside.

Before my dazed eyes, the void shrinks to the size of my palm and finally disappears.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
I fall on my butt.
I sit there dumbfounded, and the void shrinks and disappears in front of me.

pages.ja:
「今、のは
」
立ち上がる事も出来ず、背後の荒野に視線を移す。
夜明けが近い。
昇りかけた日を背にしているのは、赤い外套をまとった騎士だった。

pages.en:
“What… was that?”

Still unable to rise, I turn my eyes toward the wasteland behind me.

—Dawn is near.

Against the first light of the rising sun stands a knight in a red coat.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That… was”
I can’t stand up, and just look behind me to the flat field.
Dawn is near.
The one with the rising sun behind him is the knight in red.

pages.ja:
「あい、つ
格好、つけやがって」
つい文句が口に出る。
けれど、呟く口元は自分でも仕方がないぐらい、嬉しげに笑っていた。

pages.en:
“That… bastard. Showing off until the end.”

The complaint escapes me before I can stop it.

Yet even I can tell that my lips are curved into an irrepressibly joyful smile.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Damnshow-off.”
I complain without thinking.
But I’m smiling happily for some reason.

pages.ja:
「
ふん。まあ、言いたいコトは」
俺にはないし、いい加減眠らせてほしいから黙っていよう。
pages.jaRuby:
「
ふん。まあ、言いたいコトは」
俺にはないし、いい加減眠らせてほしいから黙っていよう。
pages.en:
“—Hmph. Well, what I want to say is…”

Nothing, really. And I want him to let me sleep already, so I keep quiet.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Heh. Well…”
I have nothing to say to him. I guess I’ll stay quiet so I can sleep.

pages.ja:
一面の荒野となった黄金の大地。
そこに佇む騎士と、そいつめがけて駆けていく遠坂の姿を認めて、背中から地面に寝ころんだ。
告げるべき言葉は、遠坂が代わりに告げてくれる筈だ。

pages.en:
The golden earth has become an unbroken wasteland.

I see the knight standing there, and Tohsaka running toward him, and allow myself to fall onto my back.

She will say everything that needs to be said in my place.
pages.mirrorMoon:
A golden field that is now deserted.
Seeing the knight standing there and Tohsaka running to him, I lay on the ground.
Tohsaka should say everything I want to say to him.

pages.ja:
だから、今は眠ろう。
顔を合わせればまたケンカになるだろうし、自分自身に別れを告げる事なんて慣れていない。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
—So for now, I will sleep.

If we met face-to-face, we would only quarrel again. Besides, I have never learned how to bid farewell to myself.
pages.mirrorMoon:
So I’ll sleep for now.
We’ll end up fighting if we see each other again, and I’m not used to parting with myself.

pages.ja:
……そうして、最後にもう一度。
忘れぬよう自分の理想を眼に焼き付けて、ゆっくりと目蓋を閉じた。
pages.jaRuby:
……そうして、最後にもう一度。
忘れぬよう自分の理想を眼に焼き付けて、ゆっくりと目蓋を閉じた。
pages.en:
…And so, one final time—

I burn my ideal into my eyes so that I will never forget it, then slowly let them close.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…And for the final time…
I engrave my ideal into my mind so that I won’t forget it, and I close my eyes.

pages.ja:
踏みしめる大地は、いつか見た荒野に似ていた。
あたりには何もない。
何もかも吹き飛んだ山頂には、もう、余分な物など何もなかった。
戦いは、終わったのだ。

pages.en:
The earth beneath his feet resembled a wasteland he had once seen.

Nothing surrounded him.

Everything atop the mountain had been blown away. Not one superfluous thing remained.

—The battle was over.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The land below him is like a wasteland he once walked on.
There is nothing here.
There is nothing, as everything was blown away from the mountaintop.
The battle has ended.

pages.ja:
聖杯を巡る戦いは終幕が過ぎ、彼の戦いもまた、ここに幕を閉じようとしていた。
それがどのくらい長かったのかなど、彼には判らない。
ただ、永遠に自己を縛り付けるであろう積念が、今は無い。
終わりはただ速やかに浸透し、この時代に現れた彼の体を透かしていく。

pages.en:
The struggle for the Holy Grail had passed beyond its conclusion, and now his own battle too was drawing to a close.

He did not know how long that battle had lasted.

He knew only that the accumulated obsession that should have bound him for eternity was gone.

The end permeated him swiftly and without violence, turning transparent the body he had assumed in this age.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The battle for the Holy Grail has ended, and the curtain is about to fall on his battle as well.
He does not know how long it was.
But the accumulated wish that should have bound him forever is gone now.
The end quickly permeates into him and takes away his body’s form.

pages.ja:
「アーチャー……！」
呼びかける声に視線を向ける。
走る余力などないだろうに、その少女は息を乱して駆けてくる。
それを、彼は黙って見守った。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Archer…!”

He turns toward the voice.

The girl cannot possibly have strength left to run, yet she comes toward him, breathless and stumbling.

He watches her approach in silence.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Archer…!”
He looks towards the voice.
She should not have the energy to run, but she is running with ragged breathing.
He watches it in silence.

pages.ja:
「はあ、はあ、はあ、は…………！」
彼の下まで走り寄った少女は、乱れた呼吸のまま騎士を見上げる。
pages.jaRuby:
「はあ、はあ、はあ、は…………！」
彼の下まで走り寄った少女は、乱れた呼吸のまま騎士を見上げる。
pages.en:
“Hah, hah, hah, hah………!”

The girl reaches him and looks up at the knight through ragged breaths.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Haa, haa, haa, ha……!”
The girl that ran up to him looks up at the knight.

pages.ja:
風になびく赤い外套に、見る影はなかった。
外套は所々が裂け、その鎧もひび割れ、砕けている。
存在は希薄。
以前のまま、出会った時と変わらぬ尊大さで佇む騎士の体は、その足下から消え始めていた。

pages.en:
—Little remains of the red coat streaming in the wind.

It is torn in a dozen places. His armor is cracked and broken.

His presence has grown faint.

The knight still stands with all the same arrogance he possessed when they first met, yet his body has begun to disappear from the feet upward.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The red cloak fluttering in the wind shows no trace of what it used to be.
The cloak is cut everywhere, and his armor is cracked and torn.
His existence is weak.
Standing there haughtily, the knight begins to disappear from his feet up.

pages.ja:
「アー、チャー」
遠くには夜明け。
地平線には、うっすらと黄金の日が昇っている。
pages.jaRuby:
「アー、チャー」

pages.en:
“Ar…cher.”

Dawn lies in the distance.

The golden edge of the sun has begun to rise above the horizon.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ar… cher…”
The rising sun is in the distance.
A golden light is emerging from the horizon.

pages.ja:
「残念だったな。そういう訳だ、今回の聖杯は諦めろ凛」
特別言うべき事もないのか。
赤い騎士はそんな、どうでもいい言葉を口にした。
pages.jaRuby:
「残念だったな。そういう訳だ、今回の聖杯は諦めろ凛」

pages.en:
“A pity. But that is how matters stand. Give up on the Holy Grail this time, Rin.”

Perhaps he has nothing in particular to tell her.

The red knight offers only those utterly trivial words.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Too bad. Well, that’s what happened. Give up this Holy Grail, Rin.”
He must not have anything special to say.
The knight in red says trivial things.

」

今にも消えようとするその体で、騎士は以前のままの騎士だったのだ。
信頼し、共に夜を駆け、皮肉を言い合いながら背中を任せた協力者。
振り返れば「楽しかった」と断言できる日々の記憶。

pages.en:
“——”

That, more than anything, is what the girl cannot bear.

Even in a body about to vanish, the knight remains the knight he always was.

Her trusted companion. The ally with whom she raced through the night, trading barbs and entrusting her back to him.

Memories of days she can look upon now and declare, without reservation, were happy.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
That gets to her all the more.
The knight who is about to disappear is still acting like before.
He is her partner that she spoke cynically with, ran through the battles with, and trusted her back to.
She can declare that those days were “fun”.

pages.ja:
それが、変わらず目の前にあってくれた。
この時、最期の瞬間に自分を助ける為に、残っていてくれたのだ。
主を失い、英雄王の宝具を一身に受けた。
現界などとうに不可能な体で、少女に助けを求める事なく、彼女たちの戦いを見守り続けた。
その終わりが、こうして目の前にある。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
—And he has remained here before her, unchanged.

He remained until this final instant so that he could save her.

He had lost his Master and received the King of Heroes' Noble Phantasms with his entire body.

Though material existence should long ago have become impossible, he watched over their battle without once calling upon the girl for help.

And now his end stands before her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
And it is still there before her eyes.
He has remained in this world to save her at the last moment.
He lost his Master and received the king of heroes’ Noble Phantasms.
His body was disappearing, but he did not come to her and ask for help, and he instead watched over this battle.
And the end is in front of her.

pages.ja:
「アーチャー」
何を言うべきか、少女には思いつかない。
肝心な時はいつだってそうなのだ。
ここ一番、何よりも大切な時に、この少女は機転を失う。

pages.en:
“Archer.”

The girl cannot think of what she should say.

It is always like this when it matters.

At the decisive moment, at the moment most precious of all, this girl loses every trace of her wit.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Archer.”
The girl cannot think of what to say.
It is always like this for her at the most crucial times.
She loses her cleverness when it counts the most.

pages.en:
“Heh——”

The faintest smile touches the knight's lips.

He had known that from the beginning.

For the red knight, the girl's very clumsiness was among the most precious of his distant memories.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ha”
The knight smiles a bit.
He knew that from the start.
The clumsiness of the girl is a dear memory for the knight.

お互い、よくもここまでボロボロになったと呆れたのだ」

pages.en:
“—Wh-what? You don't have to laugh, especially now!”

Annoyed, she glares up at him from beneath her brows.

“No, forgive me. It is only that your appearance is rather—remarkable.

“I found myself astonished at how thoroughly we have both been reduced to ruins.”

The flippant reply still bears a smile.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“W-What? You don’t have to laugh at me at a time like this!”
She looks up at the knight.
“Oh, excuse me. It’s because you look so terrible.
I was just amazed at how worn-out we are.”
He smiles while he talks.

“——”

The complete absence of regret upon his face constricts her heart.

*Is this all right?*

The instant she wonders whether it can truly be right for him to disappear like this—

“Archer. Make another contract with me.”

she speaks the one thing she should not say.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
She gets a lump in her throat after seeing his regret-free face.
The instant she wonders if he should really disappear…
“Archer. Form a contract with me again.”
She says something she shouldn’t.

“I cannot. I do not know whether you intend to retain your contract with Saber, but in either case, I have no right.

“Besides, I no longer possess a purpose. My battle ends here.”

There is no hesitation in the answer, and his resolve is unstained.

His radiant expression is the morning sky itself. How could she attempt to force him beneath it?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I cannot do that. I do not know if you will keep your contract with Saber, but I am not qualified for that.
And I do not have a goal anymore. My battle ends here.”
His reply is free of doubt and his will is strong.
His face is as bright as the rising sun, and how can she force him when he’s making a face like that?

“—This is troublesome. I have no attachment to this world, but…”

he does not want to see this girl cry.

To him, she must always face forward, always be a realist, always remain relentlessly unsentimental—or she would not be herself.

Her strength had encouraged him at every turn.

And so, until the very end, he wants this girl to remain the girl she has always been.

pages.en:
“——Rin.”

At his voice, the girl raises her downcast face.

The sight of her holding back tears is endearing.

Without betraying the small regret that has risen in his own heart, the knight glances toward the boy lying in the distance.

“Take care of me. As you know, he's a hopeless fellow.

“—I want you to support him.”

He speaks as though the matter concerns someone else.

Please support me.”

pages.en:
“——”

…There is no salvation left for this knight.

Nothing can be given to the young man who died long ago and became an immutable *phenomenon*.

Knowing that, the girl nods.

Precisely because she can give him nothing, she offers him one last radiant smile.

It is the fullest answer she can make to the trust with which he asked her to take care of *him*.

“Yes. I know. I'll do my best. I'll make sure he doesn't grow into someone as twisted as you. I'll make sure that one day, he can love himself…!

“So you—”

*Even now, it isn't too late. Forgive yourself.*

She does not speak the words.

Every emotion held within her gaze, the girl looks up at the disappearing knight.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!”
…There is no salvation available for this knight.
There is nothing to give to him, as he has already died and become a phenomenon.
She nods in spite of that.
She cannot give him anything, so she will give him her best smile.
He asked her to take care of him.
She smiles so that she can answer the trust he put in her.
“Yeah, I know. I’ll do my best. I’ll do my best so that he won’t get twisted like you. I’ll do my best so that he will be able to like himself…!
So you should also”
forgive yourself.
She does not put it into words.
She looks up at the disappearing knight with a flood of emotions.

pages.en:
“—Hmph. In the end, I never got to complain to you.”

She roughly wipes away the tears rising in her eyes and addresses the man who is no longer there.

Her voice is clear. The girl's customary strength has returned.

Naturally.

After seeing an expression like that, she has no time to stand here grieving.

She bids farewell to the wasteland where the knight stood and runs toward the fallen boy.
